task.description:
WF-02, step 1c — rework of the design of REQ-107 (docs/design/REQ-107-e2e-team-web.md) by the findings of the gate, pass 1 (handoffs/E2E107-20261116-01/step-01b-code-design-validator.json: F1 Medium, F2-F8 Low) and by decision 0113 addendum О19-О22, and only by them (AP-019). The gate's re-check is pass 2 of 3. Read the gate's result yourself (findings, mutants V01-V22, issues), not this summary.

(F1, Medium) The delay rule of team-slow.json (section 4.2) holds only while the tasks form a chain: the engine runs independent tasks two at a time (PARALLEL_DEFAULT in tools/src/team/engine/schedule.js). Make the "in work for at least 10 seconds" claim hold by construction: the rule of the scenario also checks the chain (each task depends on the one before, read from the file), and the test reads the project's journal (the time of PROJECT_DONE minus the time of PROJECT_CREATED, or the stated pair of events) and asserts at least 10000 ms; add the gate's V06 (dependency removed) to the mutants with the test that now catches it. (F2) Section 4.1: put the trap last in the merge of the stand's env, so a caller's env cannot replace it; "always the trap copy" holds by construction; add V03 to the mutants. (F3) Pin that the spec is listed in SCANNED of E2K-50 (say which test catches V21). (F4) The chat test: declare the 400 line so that both branches criterion 5 allows are green (once, as the gate's V22c/V22d), and say where the focus is for the send key, how the field is emptied, and what "the chat ready" means as a condition. (F5) Add ISS-0109 (open defect of browser.js, the file of sub-step 1) to section 20 and to О16 of the design's table, with your reading of whether sub-step 1 touches its lines. (F6) Section 7: say that the runner estimate can cross the question line 42000 ms and that this is then a question to the owner (decisions/0113 О22), and correct "question to ORCH" to "question to the owner". (F7) Section 10, item 2: the README sentence about the keychain says only what is measured or what the switch is documented to do, named as such; no unmeasured "never". (F8) Make C-1 and 4.1 say the same about whether the hash of the trap copy is checked. (О21) Add the two checks beyond the letter: the plain-words check of criterion 6 also refuses a technical code shape in the visitor's text (a token like `E_` followed by capitals, as the codes of tools/src/team/errors.js), and the progress of criterion 3 is read at least once while the project is in work with N smaller than M; add the gate's V15 and V18 to the mutants with the test that catches them. (О19) Write the scope of R2-T (a) as decision 0113 О19 says where the design describes the trap control and the kit's stand-ins.

Re-measure on your sketch after the changes: the seven tests green, each test alone green, three runs of `npm run -s e2e -- team-web` with the times, and every new or changed mutant red. Keep the rest of the design unchanged; list every changed section in result. The rule R2-T of the run stays for every trial (decision 0113 О2, О19): never start a program of tools/src with the real home as HOME or without SAI_TEAM_HOME under the temporary root; never set SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS; SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN always a recording trap; never start the real `claude`; a call naming the real home or the real Pixel Office folder goes only to a spawn that records and throws; never import a program file to read it; a command denied by the permission check is not done another way. Record before and after: whether `.sai-team` exists in the real home and the sha256 of the five files of the real Pixel Office folder. Do not use context.rework_of (reserved for -rN suffixes, decisions/0112). The text of the design holds no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner.
